notes: Sub-Saharan Africa cohort. Well-collected in French/Belgian/German/British colonial museums (Musée du quai Branly-Jacques Chirac, Royal Museum for Central Africa Tervuren, Ethnologisches Museum Berlin, British Museum). Cultural attribution is delicate — some groups span multiple modern states (Fulani across ~10 countries), many colonial museum records tag by continent ("Africa") not ethnicity. Priority is groups with well-defined material traditions.
